response.query: Which equity metrics (travel time, access index, intersectional measures) and geographic scenario inputs should be included in scenario and distributional analyses?
response.answer: Equity metrics include travel time, access index, and intersectional measures. Geographic scenario inputs should include demographic and socioeconomic factors. Focus on equity in transportation and health access.

results.title: Medicare Program; Contract Year 2024 Policy and ...
results.content: This final rule will revise the Medicare Advantage (Part C), Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit (Part D), Medicare cost plan, and Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE) regulations to implement changes related to Star Ratings, marketing and communications, health equity, provider directories, coverage criteria, prior authorization, passive enrollment, network adequacy, and other programmatic areas. The Advance Notice of Methodological Changes for Calendar Year (CY) 2019 for Medicare Advantage (MA) Capitation Rates, Part C and Part D Payment Policies and 2019 draft Call Letter discusses the clinical trial coverage policy for the MA program on pages 23-23 and is available at this link: *https://www.cms.gov/​Medicare/​Health-Plans/​MedicareAdvtgSpecRateStats/​Downloads/​Advance2019Part2.pdf*. The Announcement of Calendar Year (CY) 2011 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Medicare Advantage and Part D Payment Policies and Final Call Letter addresses this in a response to a comment on page 20-21 and is available at the following link: *https://www.cms.gov/​Medicare/​Health-Plans/​MedicareAdvtgSpecRateStats/​Downloads/​Announcement2011.pdf.*. The annual Medicare Part C & D Star Ratings Technical Notes (available online here: *https://www.cms.gov/​Medicare/​Prescription-Drug-Coverage/​PrescriptionDrugCovGenIn/​PerformanceData*) identify the measures and their data sources for each year's Star Ratings.
